title: Hooks get fresh values every render

slides.say: The code inside custom Hooks re-runs on every render of your component. So it always gets the latest props and state.
The output of use state feeds into the input of use chat room, like chaining audio effects.
Inside, they are reactive values. When room id or server URL change after a render, the Effect reconnects.

slides.text: Hooks re-run with the component, so they must be pure, like its body.
slides.say: Because Hooks run with every render, they must be pure. Think of their code as part of your component’s body.
